question: Which technical areas does CHE 339 count for?
expected_answer: Area 4A, Area 4B, and Area 5.

question: How many technical electives do I need and from how many areas?
expected_answer: Four electives in one technical area, or two in each of two areas; at least two must be engineering courses and at least one of those a CHE course.

question: When does the intent to graduate form close for Fall 2026?
expected_answer: October 27 (it opens August 24).

question: Who teaches CHE 360 in the spring?
expected_answer: Ilias Mitrai (16610) and Thomas Badgwell (16615).

question: What time does CHE 322 meet in the spring?
expected_answer: Three sections: TTH 11:00-12:30 plus W 2:00-4:00 (Ganesan; Johnston), and MTWTHF 11:30-2:30 (Zheng).

question: Do transfer physics grades count toward my technical GPA?
expected_answer: No. Transfer credit can fulfill the requirement (with a C or higher) but the grade is not added to the technical GPA.

question: How do I claim AP credit?
What AP Calculus BC score do I need to get credit for M 408C?
expected_answer: A 3-4 gives M 408C; a 5 gives M 408C (or M 408K and M 408L).

question: What AP Chemistry score gets me credit for CH 301 and CH 302?
expected_answer: 4-5, which gives CH 301, CH 302, and CH 104M/N.

question: How long are AP scores valid?
expected_answer: 10 years.

question: Should I see ChE advising or ESS advising about Q-drops?
expected_answer: ESS (Engineering Student Services) advising handles drops, withdrawals, and OTEs.

question: Is faculty advising required?
expected_answer: Required for the first 3 semesters; optional after that.

question: What is the latest semester I can take CHE 317 and still graduate in 4 years?
expected_answer: Spring 2 (spring of the second year).

question: What are the prerequisites for CHE 354?
expected_answer: CHE 319.

question: Which courses can I take in place of CH 328M?
expected_answer: CH 320M, only if you can't register for a section of CH 328M (time conflict or closed).

question: What courses count for the 4-hour chemistry elective?
How many hours can an engineering student register for without approval?
expected_answer: 17 semester hours.

question: Can I repeat a course in which I earned a C?
expected_answer: No, not for a letter grade: Cockrell students may not repeat a course in which they earned a C- or better.

question: How many times can I enroll in a lower division engineering course?
expected_answer: At most twice; a Q or W counts as an enrollment unless ESS recognizes it as nonacademic.

question: How do I make a 4-year plan in Navigate?
How do I submit my 4-year plan?
expected_answer: In Navigate, use the 3 dots on My Academic Plan > Print > Save as PDF, then submit that PDF in the Navigate 4-Year Plan Canvas assignment.

question: How many hours a week is CHE 377K research for credit?
expected_answer: 9 hours weekly.

question: How do I install Aspen on my laptop?
expected_answer: Be on UTEXAS Wi-Fi or the UT VPN, map the network drive \\austin.utexas.edu\disk\che-share\aspenONE\V14, install, and copy config.aem to C:\ProgramData\AspenTech\APED V14.0. Mac users use remote desktop or VMware.

question: Who is the undergraduate academic advisor in chemical engineering?
expected_answer: Marco Martinez-Trejo, Undergraduate Senior Academic Advisor.

question: What are the requirements to join the engineering honors program after my first year?
expected_answer: At least 24 hours in residence in the Cockrell School, at least 60 hours remaining in the degree, and rank in the top 10 percent of class and department.

question: Which humanities courses satisfy the core?
expected_answer: E 316L, E 316M, E 316N, or E 316P (prerequisite RHE 306).

question: What are the options for the government requirement?
expected_answer: Option 1: GOV 310L or CIV 303C and GOV 312L or 312P. Option 2: GOV 310L or CIV 303C and GOV 305C or 306C. Option 3: GOV 306C and GOV 305C.

question: What is CHE 339 about?
expected_answer: Introduction to Biochemical Engineering: microorganisms in chemical and biochemical syntheses, genetic manipulation of cells, enzyme technology, bioreactor and fermentation design, and separations of biological products.

question: What topics does M 427J cover?
What semester should I take CHE 350?
expected_answer: Suggested in fall of the fourth year (semester 7); the latest is spring of the fourth year.

question: What is the grading breakdown in Freeman's CHE 317?
expected_answer: Homework 10%, in-class quizzes 5%, tests 60%, final exam 25%.

question: When are the exams in Kumar's CHE 363?
expected_answer: Unit exams Feb 12, March 12, and April 16; final Saturday May 2, 8-10 AM.

question: Can I take engineering courses before transferring into engineering?
expected_answer: Possibly, for introductory courses in some departments, but it isn't required to apply.

question: How do I check prerequisite alerts in Navigate?
What textbook does CHE 363 use?
expected_answer: Kumar's section: McCabe, Smith and Harriott, Unit Operations of Chemical Engineering.

question: I got a 4 on the AP chem exam. What credit does that give me?
expected_answer: CH 301, CH 302, and CH 104M/N.

question: If I fail thermo can I just retake it?
expected_answer: Cockrell students may not repeat a course for a letter grade if they earned a C- or better; a failing grade can be repeated. Talk to an advisor first.

question: How long can I put off transport phenomena and still finish on time?
expected_answer: CHE 319 can be taken as late as fall of the third year (Fall 3).

question: What's the deadline to apply to graduate this fall?
expected_answer: The Fall 2026 intent to graduate form closes October 27.

question: Which professor is teaching process control next spring?
expected_answer: Ilias Mitrai and Thomas Badgwell.

question: What do I need to finish before I can take reactor design?
expected_answer: CHE 372 requires CHE 322, CHE 348, and CHE 354.

question: Is there a limit on how many credit hours I can take in one semester?
expected_answer: 17 hours without an approved application.

question: Can I substitute a different organic chem class?
Which electives count toward the biomedical engineering track?
Do I have to meet with my faculty advisor every semester?
expected_answer: Only during your first 3 semesters; optional after.

question: How do I get credit for working in a research lab?
How many total hours is the chemical engineering degree?
expected_answer: 129 credit hours.

question: Who do I talk to about dropping a class?
expected_answer: ESS (Engineering Student Services) advising.

question: Which chemistry classes with a lab can I use for my chem elective?
Do my AP scores expire?
expected_answer: They are valid for 10 years.

question: Do grades from community college count in my GPA?
expected_answer: No; transfer grades aren't included in the technical GPA, which uses only in-residence courses.

question: What classes should I take my first semester?
expected_answer: CH 302, CH 104M, CHE 102 (optional), CHE 210, M 408C, RHE 306, and a social and behavioral sciences course.
